purpose: Verify Step50 load-bearing estimate and conditional-hardness reduction for diagonal Z2 product quotient mixed rows.

scale_convention.epsilon: length scale of excised orbifold ball / EH core
scale_convention.t: metric-scale gluing parameter, t=epsilon^2; local bubble metric comparable to t*g_EH
scale_convention.refined_metric_core: t*(g_EH + t*h2 + ...); h2 solves linearized Ricci equation modulo first obstruction

estimate_sources: Ozuch higher-obstruction source lines 372-376: negatively oriented EH is isometric to |zeta|*EH and has opposite orientation.
Ozuch lines 496-514: h2(zeta^±), h4(zeta^±) exist and lambda_k(zeta^±)=c< R^±(H2) zeta^±, zeta_(k)^± >.
Ozuch lines 715-726 and 783-789: approximate Einstein modulo obstructions and four-dimensional EH/gluing estimates, citing Biquard Section 14.
MV Calabi lines 456-514: model exponent t^2*rho^2 and transition rho=t^-1/4; used only as exponent calibration.

reversed_bubble_check.metric_estimate_transfer: The underlying Riemannian EH metric for zeta^- is isometric/homothetic to zeta^+ EH, so local pointwise and weighted estimates transfer verbatim.
reversed_bubble_check.what_changes: The attaching map reverses the orientation on the RP3 link and the first obstruction coefficient uses the opposite chiral block R^- instead of R^+.
reversed_bubble_check.product_quotient_reason_mixed_rows_exist: For S2xS2 product quotient, R_+=R_-=diag(Lambda,0,0); choosing zeta in the two-dimensional kernel kills the vector first obstruction for either chirality at each A1 point.
reversed_bubble_check.leading_order_interaction: At first refined order the four A1 replacements are local and independent; inter-point/global Kuranishi terms occur at higher order and do not affect C0 operator pinching once first local obstructions vanish.

main_bound: For any fixed finite orientation assignment with all zeta_j in ker R_{epsilon_j}(p_j), sup ||Ric(g_t)-Lambda g_t||_op <= C*t^(1/2) in the clean model, or with a small beta-loss under Ozuch weighted norms; in either case it tends to zero.

z2_rows.spin_status: endpoint del Pezzo orientation is non-spin/odd.
z2_rows.ordinary_SW_status: b_+=1 in one orientation; chamber/perturbed SW theory has special behavior, but endpoint is not used as a no-Einstein target.
z2_rows.yau26_P4plus_implication: Endpoint one-chirality row is a known-Einstein calibration at the diffeotype level, not a counterexample target.

z2_rows.spin_status: non-spin/odd if smooth simply connected, since even unimodular signature would need divisibility not satisfied.
z2_rows.ordinary_SW_status: b_+>1 and positive scalar curvature metrics imply ordinary SW invariants vanish / SW moduli empty for generic PSC metrics; SW-based LeBrun obstructions cannot be applied directly.
z2_rows.yau26_P4plus_implication: If P4+ is true, this fixed smooth mixed-resolution manifold must carry some Einstein metric. Current session has no theorem proving existence or nonexistence.

hardness_reduction: For any actual mixed-resolution smooth manifold M_r (r=1,2,3) obtained by the diagonal Z2 construction, P4+ would imply that M_r admits some Einstein metric. Current tools in the session neither prove nor disprove such an Einstein metric; SW obstructions vanish under PSC/b_+>1, and Hitchin-Thorpe is satisfied.
not_settled: This does not settle positive collapse, negative branch, dimensions n>=5, exact smooth diffeomorphism type of mixed rows, or Lean formalization. A01's Q-Gorenstein smoothing mechanism is a live existence route but has not been verified here for mixed real rows.
